# fw info

> Reference of the fw info command: Fetch crates.io sparse index or npm registry metadata. Usage, aliases and flags.

Source: https://docs.aphrody.com/cli/info/

Fetch crates.io sparse index or npm registry metadata

## Usage

```bash
fw info <cargo|npm> <pkg>
```

## Aliases

`fw resolve` runs `fw info`.

## Subcommands

```bash
fw info cargo
fw info npm
```

The names come from the usage line.
